answer: Per-agent work escrow makes each new identity prepay a task fee; verifiers compare outputs to the existing mesa and release funds only for nonduplicate work. A clone can copy work, but duplicate checks move its fee to a hollow refund pool it cannot withdraw, adding full fee plus failed compute per extra identity. This makes the marginal clone strictly negative-EV; repeat attackers also pay the pearl-sized dispute surcharge per flagged identity.
